description: Solar PV modules is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Solar Victoria. This report shows a count of solar PV modules installed with a Solar Victoria rebate and/or loan. Installations are recorded on the day of installation. Data may be updated by Solar Victoria after the fact, where corrections are identified. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Solar Victoria. Its tags are environmental, solar panels, solar-power. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2026-02-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
